ud7.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
ud7.9:1.4: ‘samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ thūṇaṃ anuppatto’ti.
ud7.9:1.5: udapānaṃ tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūresuṃ’
ud7.9:1.6: mā te muṇḍakā samaṇakā pānīyaṃ apaṃsū”ti.
ud7.9:2.1: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
ud7.9:2.2: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud7.9:2.3: ‘iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda, etamhā udapānā pānīyaṃ āharā’ti.
ud7.9:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud7.9:3.2: idāni so bhante, udapāno thūneyyakehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūrito,
ud7.9:4.1: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi: iṅgha …pe… apaṃsūti.
ud7.9:4.2: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud7.9:4.3: ‘iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda etamhā udapānā pānīyaṃ āharā’ti.
ud7.9:4.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā pattaṃ gahetvā yena so udapāno tenupasaṅkami.
ud7.9:4.5: atha kho so udapāno āyasmante ānande upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañca bhusañca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandento maññe aṭṭhāsi.
ud7.9:5.2: acchariyaṃ vata! bho, abbhutaṃ vata! bho, tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
ud7.9:5.3: ayaṃ hi so udapāno mayi upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañca bhusañca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandento maññe aṭṭhāsī ti.
ud7.9:5.4: pattena pānīyaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud7.9:5.5: acchariyaṃ’ bhante, abbhutaṃ’ bhante. tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā.
ud7.9:5.6: ayaṃ hi so bhante udapāno mayi upasaṅkamante sabbaṃ taṃ tiṇañca bhusañca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito vissandento maññe aṭṭhāsi.
ud7.9:5.7: pivatu bhagavā pānīyaṃ, pivatu sugato pānīyaṃ”ti.
ud7.9:6.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
